title.narrative: SHIFTING THE POWER: capacity strengthening plans finalisation and annual assessment

description.narrative: Regarding the DRC 383 focused on the capacity self-assessments done in regards to the implementation of the shifting the power project, local partners have drafted their capacity strengthening plans. The purpose of the capacity strengthening plan is for local organisations to articulate and plan how they will improve their ability to determine and deliver emergency response. The capacity strengthening identify the organisation’s capacity strengthening objectives and the methods, responsibilities, budget and timeframe for achieving these. for this purpose: * A 2 day workshop will be organised from march 16 to 17 2016 with the international capacity building officer in order to wrap up and finalise all the 10 plans capacity strengthening plans that have been submitted. * Later on, the first annual capacity assessment will be undertaken in June to gauge the progress against different plans submitted by local partners.
